text: Right, B and C got a new packet, but they sense the channel as busy. So, what do we have to do? Apply back off, right? So, this means that both B and C remember our scheme is distributed. So, everyone makes decisions by itself based on the state of the system that it observes. So, B will say, "Hmm, I got a packet, but the channel is busy. What I need to do is to apply back off." So, what it will do is wait for the channel to become idle again, sense the channel idle for diffs, and then if the channel is idle for diffs, it will be able to draw an integer, right? Out of what? Out of the range zero CW min. And the same C, right? C at this point in time says, "Oh, I got a packet to drive me, but the channel is busy." So again, it knows that it has to perform back off. So what it will do, it will wait for the channel to become idle, then it needs to verify that the channel is idle for diffs. The channel will be idle because nobody else is doing anything. So the channel is idle.
